spec_match.rationale: Calls the real IDBObjectStore.getAllRecords({ count, direction }) and surfaces the {key, primaryKey, value} record shape the spec defines, contrasted with the legacy two-request getAll+getAllKeys dance; direction 'prev' verifiably reads from the end without a cursor.

interactive.rationale: Seed button, direction select, count input and two run buttons all drive a real IndexedDB; every control was clicked in this session and the output changed accordingly.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede promises seed-50, getAllRecords-vs-legacy comparison and cursor-free 'prev' — exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: count clamping (1..50) and direction variants are present, but 'nextunique'/'prevunique' are offered on an object store whose primary keys are unique by definition, so they are observationally identical to next/prev here — the one place unique directions matter (an index with duplicate keys) is not demonstrated. Running a query before seeding shows a bare header with no rows and no empty-state explanation.

conformance.rationale: The feature-level suite probes the real getAllRecords surface; existing suite untouched (immutable).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback verification, NOT chrome-devtools-mcp (auto-research.md §0 blocker applies): headless Chromium 141 driven over raw CDP — support probe reads supported; seed wrote 50 items; getAllRecords({count:5, direction:'next'}) returned keys 1..5 with primaryKey and value; direction 'prev' with count 3 returned keys 50,49,48 (end-first, cursor-free); legacy comparison ran both requests; console error channel empty; full-page screenshot read. Not exercised: a pre-133 browser's fallback branch.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only baseline injected telemetry; no showcaseTelemetry.assert for the record-shape or direction contracts.

design_system.rationale: All colours are design-system variables; output panel uses --bg-stone/--text-charcoal (AA); no button background overrides without color.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with visible labels and keyboard operability, but the #out results panel has no aria-live/role=status, so query results and the seed confirmation are visual-only for screen readers; the support line likewise updates silently.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Flex controls wrap and the output panel scrolls vertically; desktop 1280px screenshot is clean. The ≈360px touch class was not exercised in this session and the demo's responsive-support record predates this review.

openQuestions.title: Announce query results and seed state to screen readers
openQuestions.detail: Give #out (and the support line) aria-live=polite or role=status so 'seeded 50 items' and query results are announced. The result text is short enough that announcement spam is not a concern.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate nextunique/prevunique where they actually differ
openQuestions.detail: On an object store the primary keys are unique, so 'nextunique' is indistinguishable from 'next'. Add an index with duplicate keys (e.g. a 'category' index over the seeded items) and run getAllRecords against the index, where unique directions return one record per distinct key — the only situation the unique variants exist for. Could be an in-place extension or a new concept (suggestedSlug: index-unique-directions).

openQuestions.title: Show an empty-state message when querying before seeding
openQuestions.detail: Running getAllRecords before seeding prints the header line and nothing else (observed: 'getAllRecords({ count: 5, direction: "next" }) — 10.30ms' with an empty body). Say '0 records — click "seed db" first' so the empty result reads as a state, not a glitch.

openQuestions.title: Fix the unsupported-fallback copy
openQuestions.detail: The unsupported branch says 'Falling back to getAll demo below', but nothing is below — the legacy comparison is a sibling button. Reword to point at the 'legacy getAll / getAllKeys' button.

summary: Weekly hardening critique 2026-10-18 (headless Chromium 141 + raw CDP cloud fallback, not chrome-devtools-mcp; URL /v133/indexeddb-getallrecords-and-direction-option-for-getall-getallkeys/all-records/): a genuinely working demo of the real API — seed, next/prev directions and the legacy comparison all verified live with clean console; 'prev' count 3 returned keys 50,49,48 proving end-first reads. Gaps: results panel is not a live region, unique directions are demoed where they cannot differ (object store, no index), empty-store queries show a bare header, and the unsupported copy references a demo that is not 'below'.
